description: Change nameservers: 2 to 13 hostnames, or "default" to return to Nymwell DNS. Pointing elsewhere means the records in Nymwell stop applying. Applies at once when you act for an owner or admin and the workspace lets agents apply changes (the default); otherwise it waits in list_approvals. workflow.state says which.
name: set_nameservers
title: Set nameservers
